rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The divine name is mighty; those who seek refuge, rely on it, and use it as a means to God attain honor and success in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز عز من التجا إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever draws near to God is brought near; God fulfills the plea of one who complains to Him and grants the need of one who petitions Him.
rows.anchor: فمن تقرب منه قربه ومن شكا إليه حقق له مطلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Expanding the Prophet's breast means widening his heart for Islam.
rows.anchor: ألم نوسع قلبك للإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that God softened the Prophet's heart for faith.
rows.anchor: ألم نلينه للإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that God expanded the Prophet's breast with the light of messengership.
rows.anchor: ويقال ألم نوسع صدرك بنور الرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that God expanded the Prophet's breast to receive what He sent down to him.
rows.anchor: نوسع صدرك لقبول ما نورد عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The burden removed from the Prophet is his sin before prophethood.
rows.anchor: أي : إثمك قبل النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, God protected the Prophet from committing sin, removing a burden he had never incurred.
rows.anchor: عصمناك عن ارتكاب الوزر ؛ فوضعه عنه بأنه لم يستوجبه قط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, God lightened the burdens of prophethood and made the Prophet carried by divine aid rather than bearing them alone.
rows.anchor: خفضنا عنك أعباء النبوة وجعلناك محمولا لا متحملا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God strengthened the Prophet to endure people and witness Him, preserved his trust, and guarded him from attending to people amid his honor.
rows.anchor: قويناك لمشاهدتنا ، وحفظنا عليك ما استحفظت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The burden weighed down the Prophet's back so heavily that without God's carrying it for him, it would have broken him.
rows.anchor: أثقله ، ولولا حملنا عنك لكسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raised the Prophet's mention by joining it to His own: the testimony is not valid without mention of both.
rows.anchor: فكما لا تصح كلمة الشهادة إلا بي ، فإنها لا تصح إلا بك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that God raised the Prophet's mention through people's saying, “Muhammad is God's Messenger.”
rows.anchor: ويقال : رفعنا لك ذكرك بقول الناس : محمد رسول الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that God established the honor of the Prophet's messengership.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أثبتنا لك شرف الرسالة

rows.speaker: الخبر
rows.claim: A report says that one hardship cannot overcome two eases.
rows.anchor: وفي الخبر : ( لن يغلب عسر يسرين )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated definite “hardship” refers to one known hardship, while the two indefinite instances of “ease” indicate two distinct eases.
rows.anchor: العسر بالألف واللام في الموضعين للعهد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The single hardship is worldly adversity; the two eases are worldly prosperity and relief from trials, followed by reward in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: والعسر الواحد : ما كان في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All believers share the hardship of worldly trials, while their two eases are relief in this life and recompense tomorrow.
rows.anchor: هو ما نابهم من شدائد الدنيا ، ويسرهم اثنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the Prophet finishes his obligatory prayer, he should devote himself to supplication.
rows.anchor: فإذا فرغت من الصلاة المفروضة عليك فانصب في الدعاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that after finishing worship, the Prophet should devote himself to intercession.
rows.anchor: ويقال : فإذا فرغت من العبادة فانصب في الشفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that after finishing worship of the self, the Prophet should devote himself inwardly with his heart.
rows.anchor: ويقال : فإذا فرغت من عبادة نفسك فانصب بقلبك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should turn his desire toward his Lord in every circumstance.
rows.anchor: في جميع الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that after conveying the message, the Prophet should seek intercession from his Lord.
rows.anchor: ويقال : فإذا فرغت من تبليغ الرسالة فارغب في الشفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name signals His eternal majesty and beauty, and points to His eternal reception and generosity.
rows.anchor: اسم الله يدل على جلال من لم يزل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knower is overwhelmed by divine majesty, the chosen one lives through divine beauty, the saint trembles at divine acceptance, and the seeker needs no livelihood alongside God's sufficiency.
rows.anchor: فالعارف شهد جلاله فطاش ، والصفي شهد جماله فعاش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fig is a great blessing because it has no pit, is free of irritating blemish, and is sized to complete the pleasure of a single bite.
rows.anchor: أقسم بالتين لما به من عظيم المنة على الخلق حيث لم يجعل فيه النوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The olive has many uses, including providing lamp oil, food seasoning, and a dipping condiment.
rows.anchor: من المنافع مثل الاستصباح والتأدم والاصطباغ به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sinai is the mountain where God spoke to Moses.
rows.anchor: الجبل الذي كلم الله موسى عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A place touched by the feet of God's beloved has sanctity.
rows.anchor: ولموضع قدم الأحباب حرمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The secure city is Mecca, honored as the city of the Beloved and the location of the House.
rows.anchor: فهي بلد الحبيب ، وفيها البيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Beloved's House and city possess rank and worth.
rows.anchor: ولبيت الحبيب وبلد الحبيب قدر ومنزلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity was created in the best stature through upright posture and the beautiful arrangement of its limbs.
rows.anchor: في اعتدال قامته ، وحسن تركيب أعضائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This wording establishes that God has no form or bodily configuration: when an attribute is shared with creation, its perfection belongs to God, yet the verse calls the human form the best stature.
rows.anchor: ليس له صورة ولا هيئة ؛ لأن كل صفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation of being returned to the lowest state is reaching decrepit old age, senility, and infirmity.
rows.anchor: إلى أراذل العمر وهو حال الخرف والهرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is being returned to Hell and the abyss in the ugliest form; on this reading, the opening is general and the ending refers specifically to disbelievers.
rows.anchor: إلى النار والهاوية في أقبح صورة ؛ فيكون أول الآية عاما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The old-age interpretation applies only to some people, since not everyone reaches senility.
rows.anchor: إذ ليس كل الناس يبلغون حال الهرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reward promised to believers who do good will not be diminished.
rows.anchor: غير ممنون } . أي : غير منقوص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that being returned to the lowest state means a state of misery and disbelief, from which believers are excepted.
rows.anchor: إلى حال الشقاوة والكفر إلا المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Given all the proof and clarification, the human being has no basis for denying the Judgment.
rows.anchor: أيها الأنسان . . مع كل هذا البرهان والبيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When sinners hear God's name, they forget their lapses in view of His mercy; worshippers forget their own force before His divinity.
rows.anchor: كلمة إذا سمعها العاصون نسوا زلتهم في جنب رحمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name suffices for every concern, sets matters right, forgives sins, and grants needs.
rows.anchor: كلمة من سمعها ما غادرت له شغلا إلا كفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Qāriʿah is a name for the Resurrection, derived from a word for a forceful blow; it is called that because it strikes people.
rows.anchor: القارعة : اسم من أسماء القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asking what the Qāriʿah is serves to magnify and terrify the listener.
rows.anchor: ومآ أدراك ما القارعة } . تهويلا لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People like scattered moths are dispersed; when resurrected, they will also pile upon one another.
rows.anchor: وعند إعادتهم يركب بعضهم بعضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains will be like fluffed, dyed wool.
rows.anchor: كالعهن المنفوش } . أي : كالصوف المصبوغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worldly claimants and powerful will become weaker than the weakest at resurrection, because power will collapse and claims will fail.
rows.anchor: لأن القوى هنالك تسقط ، والدعاوى تبطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose scales are heavy with good deeds will have a pleasing life; “pleasing” means made pleasing to them.
rows.anchor: من ثقلت موازينه بالخيرات فهو في عيشة راضية ؛ أي مرضية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One account says deeds are weighed through the weighing of their written records.
rows.anchor: ووزن الأعمال يومئذ يكون بوزن الصحف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account says a substance will be created for each component of a person's acts, and those substances will be weighed as the deeds' measure.
rows.anchor: ويقال : يخلق بدل كل جزء من أفعاله جوهرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose scales are light in acts of obedience are the disbelievers, whose abode is the abyss.
rows.anchor: من خفت موازينه من الطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about the nature of the blazing Fire is asked to intensify terror.
rows.anchor: ومآ أدراك ماهية نار حامية } . سؤال على جهة التهويل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The text does not report that states themselves are weighed; each person is instead repaid through a state they acquired or whose causes they acquired.
rows.anchor: ولم يرد الخبر بأن الأحوال توزن ، ولكن يجازى كل بحالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name was holy before eternity, needs no time or place in the future, and cannot be circumscribed by spatial limits.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز تقدس في آزاله عن كل مكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because no number can circumscribe God, increase or decrease cannot be attributed to Him.
rows.anchor: لا يقطعه حد فأنى يجوز في وصفه المكان ؟ ولا يقطعه عد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People's mutual boasting occupied them through the end of their lives, until they died.
rows.anchor: أي : شغلكم تفاخركم فيما بينكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is that they boasted of their forefathers and ancestors, celebrating the living and those who had died.
rows.anchor: ويقال : كانوا يفتخرون بآبائهم وأسلافهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their boasting led them to count their dead as they counted the living, and their competition in wealth and children distracted them from obedience to God.
rows.anchor: وأنساكم تكاثركم بالأموال والأولاد طاعة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated warning that they will soon know is for intensification and intimidation.
rows.anchor: كلا سوف تعلمون ثم كلا سوف تعلمون } . على جهة التهويل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they knew with true certainty, they would desist from their denial.
rows.anchor: لو علمتم حق اليقين لارتدعتم عما أنتم فيه من التكذيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about blessings concerns everything God gave them, for which He demands gratitude.
rows.anchor: أراد جميع ما أعطاهم الله من النعمة ، وطالبهم بالشكر عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation of the blessings is the easing of religious obligations and dispensations in worship.
rows.anchor: تخفيف الشرائع ؛ والرخص في العبادات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation includes hot water in winter and cold water in summer.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الماء الحار في الشتاء ، الماء البارد في الصيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation includes bodily health and free time.
rows.anchor: منه الصحة في الجسد ، والفراغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is contentment with God's decree.
rows.anchor: والفراغ . ويقال : الرضاء بالقضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is contentment with one's livelihood.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الرضاء بالقضاء . ويقال : القناعة في المعيشة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is the Prophet, al-Muṣṭafā.
rows.anchor: ويقال : القناعة في المعيشة . ويقال : هو المصطفى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever hears God's name does not withhold wealth from it, knowing that God will make his final outcome good.
rows.anchor: كلمة من سمعها لم يدخر عنها ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever knows God's name does not prefer himself over it, since his intimacy was not found apart from it.
rows.anchor: ومن عرفها لم يؤثر عليها نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever accompanies God's name does not withhold his spirit from it, having been granted eternal life through it.
rows.anchor: كلمة من صحبها لم يمنع عنها روحه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿAṣr means time or the age, by which God swears.
rows.anchor: العصر } : الدهر - أقسم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation of al-ʿAṣr is the afternoon prayer.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أراد به صلاة العصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation of al-ʿAṣr is evening.
rows.anchor: ويقال : أراد به صلاة العصر . ويقال : هو العشي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Humanity” refers to the human species, and loss means perdition.
rows.anchor: الإنسان } : أراد به جنس الإنسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity is in punishment for its sins.
rows.anchor: المعنى : إن الإنسان لفي عقوبة من ذنوبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers who are excepted worship sincerely and urge one another to truth, what is good and beautiful, and patience.
rows.anchor: الذين أخلصوا في العبادة وتواصوا بما هو حق

rows.speaker: بعض التفاسير
rows.claim: One exegetical mapping identifies the believers with Abū Bakr, good works with ʿUmar, enjoining truth with ʿUthmān, and enjoining patience with ʿAlī.
rows.anchor: وفي بعض التفاسير : قوله : { الذين آمنوا } يعني أبا بكر ، { وعملوا الصالحات } : يعني عمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human loss has two kinds: loss in deeds becomes clear in the final outcome, while loss in spiritual states becomes clear in the present moment.
rows.anchor: والخسران الذي يلحق الإنسان على قسمين : في الأعمال ويتبين ذلك في المآل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Loss in spiritual states appears as contraction after expansion, veiling after nearness, and returning to dispensations after choosing the harder and better path.
rows.anchor: وفي الأحوال ويتبين ذلك في الوقت والحال ؛ وهو القبض بعد البسط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The additional form of state loss is returning to dispensations after preferring the harder and better path.
rows.anchor: والرجوع إلى الرخص بعد إيثار الأشق والأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enjoining truth means preferring others in dealings with people and being sincere with God.
rows.anchor: وهو الإيثار مع الخلق ، والصدق مع الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience means enduring well-being, which is the fullest form of patience.
rows.anchor: وتواصوا بالصبر } : على العافية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is patience with God, which is among the most difficult forms of patience.
rows.anchor: ويقال : بالصبر مع الله . . وهو أشد أقسام الصبر
